hook_en: A life rooted in Him leaves a legacy. 🙏
reflect_en: Psalm 112 describes the person who fears the LORD and greatly delights in His commandments, and it says the generation of the upright will be blessed. What lasts isn't what we pile up, but a life of reverence that blesses the people who come after us. As the week winds down, ask God to make your faithfulness the kind that endures.
q_en: Who in your life showed you what it looks like to delight in God?
x_en: Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who greatly delights in His commandments.
tiktok: What will you pass on? 🙏 Psalm 112:1–3 — the generation of the upright will be blessed
yt_title: Blessed Is the One Who Fears the LORD | Psalm 112:1–3 #Shorts
li_open: The best legacy isn't a result; it's a way of living.
li_quote: His descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
li_body: Psalm 112 connects a life of reverence for God with blessing that reaches the next generation. Leaders in churches, ministries and businesses shape the people who come after them, and one of the most lasting things we can pass on is a habit of praying faithfully for the people in our care.
hook_es: Una vida en Dios deja huella. 🙏
reflect_es: El Salmo 112 habla del que teme a Jehová y en sus mandamientos se deleita en gran manera, y promete que la generación de los rectos será bendita. Lo que permanece no es lo que acumulamos, sino una vida que honra a Dios y bendice a los que vienen detrás. Al cerrar esta semana, pídele a Dios que tu fidelidad sea de las que permanecen.
q_es: ¿Quién te enseñó con su vida a deleitarte en Dios?
x_es: Bienaventurado el hombre que teme a Jehová, y en sus mandamientos se deleita en gran manera.
key_en: generation of the upright will be blessed
key_es: la generación de los rectos será bendita
